name: dois-pontos
description: Dois Pontos - rotina e finanças para casais

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @dois-pontos/api" "npm run dev -w @dois-pontos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dois-pontos/api && npm run build -w @dois-pontos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dois-pontos/api && npm run typecheck -w @dois-pontos/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dois-pontos/api && npm run test -w @dois-pontos/web
